name: github_automation_scan
description: Scan GitHub for eligible review, feedback, or labeled issue revisions and build bounded dynamic dispatch tasks.

kind.description: Automation sweep kind: 'review' scans open PRs for review, 'address' scans PRs for actionable reviewer feedback, 'issue' scans labeled open issues without a linked PR.

maxNew.description: Maximum newly-eligible candidates to dispatch this sweep. Defaults to 5 for 'review', 2 for 'address', 1 for 'issue'.

maxActive.description: Maximum concurrently-active (in-flight) automation runs allowed before new candidates are capacity-blocked; defaults to maxNew.

issueLabel.description: Label an issue must carry to be eligible when kind is 'issue'.

data.description: Any additional properties are passed through verbatim as extra input to each dispatched automation_dispatch sub-workflow.

scanned.description: Number of source PRs or issues fetched from GitHub for this sweep.

eligible.description: Number of candidates selected for dispatch within capacity.

active.description: Number of in-flight (active-status) automation workflows found for the tracked candidates.

kind.description: Automation sweep kind for this candidate.

childWorkflow.description: Name of the child workflow to launch (pr_review, address_pr, or issue_to_pr).

childWorkflowVersion.description: Version of the child workflow to launch.

revision.description: Revision fingerprint (head SHA or feedback fingerprint) this candidate targets.

attempt.description: Attempt count for this revision, from prior trusted markers.

url.description: HTML URL of the PR or issue.

skipped.description: Candidates excluded from dispatch, each annotated with a 'reason' (e.g. draft, no_feedback, retry_backoff, suppressed, exhausted, label_or_state, linked_pr).

blocked.description: Otherwise-eligible candidates deferred purely due to capacity (reason: 'capacity').

dynamicTasks.description: Conductor FORK_JOIN_DYNAMIC task definitions, one automation_dispatch sub-workflow per eligible candidate.

dynamicTasksInput.description: Map of dynamic task reference name to its sub-workflow input, keyed to dynamicTasks.
